searchText: naive question here, why not strings still for integers? "target":"3" only because numbers are actually defined in the json spec, so not using strings for thems reduces ambiguity https://www.json.org/json-en.html oops missed the response... but I think we chose to do string in other places for some reasons on how numbers are limited ( might not apply in this case) but we definitely chose to use string for numbers in several places including all the beacon api specs It's because JSON is based on JavaScript and JavaScript always uses doubles for numbers so has limited accuracy. If you use a plain number for something like an account balance and parse the JSON with javascript you can wind up with an incorrect balance (and I don't think there's anything you can do about it, but not sure if that's changed in more recent versions now that they do have BigInt)
